reviewer: Separate Claude review agent, independent of the extractor; no human review claimed
scope: Independent review of the NeuSomatic SEQC2 batch for use-case-tumour-dna-somatic-variant-detection: 2,595 records (2,464 results, 96 evaluations, 17 configurations, 6 protocols, 6 claims, 3 datasets, 2 sources, 1 method). Both pinned artifacts were re-downloaded and matched their recorded SHA-256; archived copies decompress to the same bytes. All 2,464 results were re-read from the PDF word boxes with the reviewer's own parser (the extractor's scripts were not run); column identity was confirmed against the article prose and every printed Average matches its row mean within 0.05. No number changed. 42 evaluations of SEQC2-trained or unidentified models are excluded from the six judgements. Details in docs/reviews/use-cases/tumour-dna-somatic-variant-detection-neusomatic-2026-10-10.md.
limitations: Automated review by a Claude agent; not human scientific review and not reproduction of any caller.
The PDF text was read with poppler pdftotext, the same tool the extractor used; column identity was checked independently against the article prose and the SNV-only columns.
Figures, Additional file 1 and Tables S5 to S10 were not checked.

SHACL shapes and npm run build were not run; npm test and npm run typecheck passed, and an in-memory addBatch and deriveUseCaseInputs dry run passed with all six new and all 16 existing judgements active.

errors.message: NeuSomatic and NeuSomatic-S SEQC-WGS-Spike, SEQC-WGS-GT-50 and SEQC-WGS-GT50-SpikeWGS10 (trained on SEQC2 HCC1395 data) and Octopus-RF (forest not identified, possibly SEQC2-trained), on all six protocols.
Overlap notes said the evaluation region was shared with training, which is wrong for SEQC-WGS-GT-50; Octopus-RF training stated as fact where the source conflicts. Rewritten per model.
Limitations and constraints rewritten from the source (truth-set and SomaticSeq authorship, patent, ensemble inputs, site codes); two unsupported statements removed.

excluded_evaluations.reason: Trained on the test cell line: the SEQC-WGS-GT-50 model was trained on HCC1395/HCC1395BL WGS replicates with the SEQC2 truth set in the other 50% of the high-confidence genome (Methods). The scored region is held out, but the cell line, truth set and possibly the replicate pairs are the same.

Trained on the test cell line: the SEQC-WGS-GT50-SpikeWGS10 model combines the SEQC-WGS-GT-50 training data (HCC1395 truth in the other half of the genome) with 10% of the SEQC-WGS-Spike data (HCC1395BL spike-ins across the genome) (Methods), and was chosen as the default model from these same evaluations.

Trained on the test cell line: the SEQC-WGS-Spike model was trained on in silico tumours made by spiking mutations into HCC1395BL WGS replicates (the normal of the scored pair) from four sites, over the whole genome (Methods; Additional file 2 Table S1), so its training data share the cell line, sequencing and scored region with this test.
